remarks:
VERY VERY MOTIVATED SELLER!! BRING ALL OFFERS!! Your own private retreat awaits at 170 Creek Rd! Tucked into a peaceful wooded setting with an East Aurora mailing address, this updated spacious 4-bedroom, 2-full-bath home offers 2,310 sq ft of versatile living space and the kind of property that invites you to slow down and enjoy where you live. Wander through the woods and follow the property down to a walkable creek—a special backdrop for morning walks, exploring nature, relaxing by the water, or simply escaping the everyday.

Updates include a full kitchen remodel with maple cabinetry, tier IV quartzite stone countertops w/counter-to-ceiling backsplash, neutral paint throughout, waterproof LVP flooring, all new windows, 5yr old tear off rood and all new siding.

The sale includes an additional .85-acre parcel, SBL# 144200-156-000-0002-005-000, bringing the property to a total of 2.75 acres and creating an impressive combination of privacy, recreation and outdoor space.

Inside, you'll find a flexible layout designed to adapt to the way you live. The eat-in kitchen, generous living areas, a first-floor bedroom, den/study and bonus room provide options for guests, working from home, hobbies or additional living space. Downstairs, the finished full basement with exterior walkout expands the possibilities even further with room for recreation, entertaining, or creating a space all your own, even easily converted to an in-law living area.

Outside is where this property truly comes alive. Spend summer days around the above-ground pool, entertain or unwind on the deck, explore the wooded grounds and creek, or simply enjoy the privacy and changing seasons around you. The heated attached 2-car garage with electric and water offers excellent space for vehicles, projects, or hobbies, and a shed provides additional storage.

Located in the highly sought-after Iroquois School District and convenient to East Aurora, this is more than a house—it is a place to spread out, explore, entertain, and enjoy your own piece of Western New York. Come experience 170 Creek Rd and discover just how special this setting feels.
